questions.intro: Customers judge a business by how easy it is to reach. A BUSINESS EMAIL that uses the company's own web domain (like hello@yourshop.example) looks more established than a free personal address. A separate business phone number (a second line or a calling app) keeps personal and business calls apart and protects privacy. Record a short voicemail greeting with the business name and when callers can expect a reply. Then answer within the time you promise; a clear, kept promise builds trust.
